gdp_yoy.source: MoSPI Provisional Estimates of GDP for Q4 FY2025-26 and PE FY2025-26 (released June 5, 2026). Q4 (Jan-Mar 2026) grew 7.8% YoY, down from ~8% in Q3 FY26 (Oct-Dec 2025), though full-year FY26 came in at 7.7% vs 6.5% in FY25.

cpi.source: MoSPI Consumer Price Index press release for June 2026 (released July 13, 2026, embargoed 4 PM). All-India CPI YoY inflation rose to 4.38% from 3.93% in May 2026 — an 18-month high, driven by CFPI (food) accelerating to 5.32% from 4.78%.

rate_cut_cycle.note: RBI MPC held repo rate at 5.25% on June 5, 2026 (third consecutive hold; unanimous decision), maintaining neutral stance. FY27 GDP growth forecast cut to 6.6% (from 6.9%) and inflation forecast raised to 5.1% (from 4.6%), citing West Asia conflict, elevated crude, and monsoon/El Niño uncertainty. No new MPC meeting since; next bi-monthly review due August 2026.
rate_cut_cycle.source: RBI MPC Resolution, June 2026 (via Forbes India MPC live coverage).

gov_capex.note: CPSEs met 25% of their FY27 cumulative capex target in Q1 (Apr-Jun 2026); capex by 63 CPSEs rose 26% YoY to ₹2.10 lakh crore, led by Railway Board (33% of annual target) and NHAI (24% of target). Broader govt capex (Centre+states+CPSEs) rose 19% YoY in Apr-May 2026. FY27 capex budget of ₹12.2 lakh crore (+11.5% vs FY26 RE) push remains on track.
gov_capex.source: Business Standard, 'CPSEs meet 25% of FY27 cumulative capital expenditure target in Q1' (July 6, 2026).

china_plus_one.note: Commerce Ministry/PMO drawing up list of 100+ products (electronics, semiconductors, chemicals, autos, pharma APIs) for import substitution to cut China reliance and scale domestic manufacturing. Manufacturing FDI now growing faster than services FDI, described as a structural shift. New smartphone manufacturing scheme targets ~₹39 lakh crore in production with deeper local value capture (R&D, components), moving beyond pure assembly.
china_plus_one.source: ChinaPulse.com, 'Centre Eyes Import Substitution Push to Cut Reliance on China' (July 16, 2026); TechCrunch, India smartphone manufacturing coverage (July 15, 2026).

rural_recovery.note: Monsoon deficit narrowed to 7% below normal (Jul 1-20) from a 40% shortfall in June, but East/Northeast India (-36%) and the South Peninsula (-26%) still lag badly. Kharif sowing is recovering unevenly — still running ~6% below last year as of mid-July, with cotton, oilseeds, pulses and coarse cereals most affected — though pace is improving as rains catch up.
rural_recovery.source: BusinessToday, 'Kharif sowing gains pace despite weak monsoon, recovery uneven across crops' (July 21, 2026), citing IMD and Agriculture Ministry data.

put_call_ratio.source: NiftyTrader.in Nifty 50 option chain PCR aggregate (total put OI / total call OI), as of July 24, 2026, 4:10 PM IST. Volume PCR was 0.93 the same day.
